from vpython import *

import random
box(opacity = 0.4, size = vec(102, 102, 102))

for i in range(100000) :
    rate(10000)
    b = box()
    x = random.randint(0,99) - 50
    y = random.randint(0,99) - 50
    z = random.randint(0,99) - 50
    b.pos = vec(x,y,z)
    b.color = vec(x/100, y/100, z/100)
